chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us from Isma'il ibn Mihran from Sayf ibn Amira from Sulayman ibn Ja'far al-Nakha'i from Muhammad ibn Muslim and others from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him). He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about the best of worshipers, so he said:
Those who, when they do good, are gladdened; when they do evil, seek forgiveness; when given, are thankful; when tested, are patient; and when angered, forgive.

key_terms.اسْتَغْفَرُوا: They seek forgiveness (istighfar): turning to God in repentance after wrongdoing
key_terms.خِيَارِ الْعِبَادِ: The best of worshipers: referring to the most virtuous among God's servants

ai.seo_question: What are the five qualities of the best worshipers according to the Prophet Muhammad in al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him) reported that the Prophet Muhammad was asked about the best of worshipers. He described them with five characteristics: when they do good, they are gladdened; when they do evil, they seek forgiveness; when given, they are thankful; when tested, they are patient; and when angered, they forgive. This concise hadith establishes a practical ethical framework that balances spiritual and social virtues.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abi `Abdullah al-Barqi narrated to us from Isma`il b. Mehran from Sayf b. `Amira from Sulayman b. Ja`far al-Nakha`I from Muhammad b. Muslim and others from Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) was asked about the best of worshipers, so he said:

Those whom, if they do good, they are gladdened; and if they do evil, they seek forgiveness; and if they are given, they are thankful; and if they face calamity, they are patient; and if they get angry, they seek pardon.
